description: This Java class defines an immutable placeholder for source addresses, used in MQTT message processing to resolve message topics. It implements support checks and resolution for the placeholder '{{ source:address }}'.

classes.name: ImmutableSourceAddressPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class implementing SourceAddressPlaceholder, representing a placeholder for source address information in message processing.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'source' used in the placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list containing the supported placeholder name '{{ source:address }}'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the placeholder name matches 'address', ignoring case.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder with the input if the name is supported, returning it wrapped in an Optional.
